headword: {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}

definitions.gloss: university faculty member; college instructor; academic staff
definitions.explanation: A person who teaches or conducts research at a university. An umbrella term covering professors, associate professors, lecturers, and assistant professors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大学教員|だいがくきょういん}です。
examples.english: My father is a university faculty member.

examples.japanese: {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: University faculty members carry out both research and teaching.

examples.japanese: {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公募|こうぼ}→公募：16155_koubo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{博士号|はくしごう}→博士号：16350_hakushigou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: To apply for a university faculty position, a doctoral degree and a certain level of research accomplishment are required.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧ (university) and ⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧ (teaching staff, instructor). This is the standard general term for any person employed in a teaching or research role at a university, regardless of rank.

Japanese universities have a hierarchy of academic positions: ⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧ (professor), ⟦{准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ}→准教授：19861_junkyouju⟧ (associate professor), ⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧ (lecturer), and ⟦{助教|じょきょう}→助教：27895_jokyou⟧ (assistant professor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公募|こうぼ}→公募：16155_koubo⟧: open recruitment for faculty positions
- {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a university instructor
- {大学教員|だいがくきょういん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a university faculty member

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧: professor — the highest academic rank
- ⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧: researcher — broader term not limited to university-affiliated roles
- ⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧: teacher — more commonly used for primary and secondary school teachers
